title: OUTDATED MAP: LIVE SAFETY
subtitle: A crate delivery changed the aisle after the survey. Reach the exit using only live robot observations.
briefing: The prior map describes the walls and exit, but the aisle changed after the survey.
The physical obstacle still produces LiDAR returns and collisions. It is absent only from the prior map.
The rolling local map, planner validator, and independent safety monitor use live ROBOT observations.
Reach the exit without contact. SIM truth scores the outcome but never tells ROBOT where the obstacle is.

walkaround.title: LIVE OBSERVATION
walkaround.lesson: Timed range returns reveal geometry that a prior survey does not contain. The robot receives ranges, never a simulator object label.

walkaround.title: LOCAL PLAN AND VALIDATION
walkaround.lesson: The local planner proposes motion from the rolling sensor map. A separate validator checks each rollout against the current observation.

walkaround.title: INDEPENDENT SAFETY GATE
walkaround.lesson: The final collision monitor checks fresh raw scan geometry before a command reaches the wheels. It can stop motion but cannot make an unsafe command faster.

prediction.question: What should happen when the live scan reveals an obstacle missing from the prior map?

choices.label: ROBOT observes it, changes motion safely, and completes without contact
choices.explanation: Live local geometry and the final raw-scan gate remain authoritative even when the global prior is stale.

choices.label: ROBOT follows the prior route through the obstacle
choices.explanation: A prior map is a planning input, not permission to ignore current range measurements.

choices.label: ROBOT must stop forever because the prior is imperfect
choices.explanation: A local detour can remain safe when live observations provide enough free space.

running_prompt: Watch the measured scan, rolling estimate, planner decision, and final Safety verdict. The unreported crate exists in physics but not in the prior map.

debrief.success_title: LIVE EVIDENCE OVERRULED THE STALE PRIOR
lessons: A static map is a prior. Fresh local sensing remains authoritative for collision avoidance.
The planner validator and final safety gate consume ROBOT observations, not simulator truth.
SIM independently checks contact and physical arrival after the run.
